title: Egyptian Tagine Chicken
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish from Egyptian cuisine, featuring tender chicken and a rich tagine sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the green pepper until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the yummy spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tagine sauce and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the pot and simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 20-25 minutes.
Stir in the egyptian yogurt and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with green olives.
